title: AnalystConfig
description: dialogue.analyst.* configuration (ADR 0047). Nested under the dialogue section. Every ability defaults false. Caps have safe defaults. Application and tenant levels may only narrow (most restrictive wins); see abilities schema.

enabled.description: Master switch for the analyst path. false (default): single-capability path only. true still requires each ability and analyst_capable.

abilities.description: Per-ability toggles at this config level. Absent key = false.

max_steps.description: Max step proposals per turn including answer.

max_total_records.description: Max rows across all datasets in a turn.

max_turn_tokens.description: Soft cap on prompt+output tokens across model calls in the turn.

max_turn_wall_ms.description: Wall-clock budget for the analyst loop in milliseconds.

max_turn_cost.description: Optional upper bound on estimated micro-units for the turn (provider budget). Null/absent: only the usual budgets apply.

web.description: Web search/fetch settings. Provider off until configured.

provider.description: Adapter id: brave, tavily, searxng, or provider_native. Empty = disabled.

cred_ref.description: Opaque reference to the API credential in the credentials service (never a secret in YAML or logs). Required for brave and tavily when those providers are enabled; optional for searxng; unused for provider_native (uses the routed model's own search).

origin.description: http(s) origin for a self-hosted SearXNG (or similar). Operator-configured endpoint; internal http is fine. No credentials, query or fragment. Required when provider or fallback is searxng.

fallback.description: Optional search backend used when provider is provider_native but the routed profile lacks native_web_search or egress does not allow provider_native. Empty = no fallback (typed web_search_unavailable). cred_ref and origin apply to the fallback the same way they apply when that backend is the primary provider.

allow_hosts.description: Deployment-level host suffixes allowed for fetch. Intersected with tenant allow_hosts and package preferred_web_hosts. Empty with web_fetch on refuses every fetch until configured.

deny_hosts.description: Deployment-level host suffixes always denied. Unioned with tenant deny_hosts; deny wins over allow.
